title: Keel: A Frontier Model Teaches a Vision-Language Model by Rewriting Its Weights

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Small reasoning VLMs such as Qwen3.5 need such a repair: in thinking mode they fall into loops on many image questions, repeating themselves until the token limit, spending the whole budget and losing the answer.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Told only the symptom, an editor, a frontier multimodal LLM acting as an agent, locates the cause, edits the weights and tests them, with a failure census and instruments showing it the failing images and where the VLM attends; among several editors, the harness keeps only edits that clearly reduce the failure without lowering accuracy on questions no editor saw.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Because the repair lives in the weights, it combines with budget forcing where held-out questions favor it: on the best available weights, Keel has the best average accuracy on both models, significantly above every training-free baseline we compare on the larger one.
